visual_identity.core_identity: A small vicious rooster-reptile hybrid combining a cock's head and comb with leathery wings, clawed feet, and a serpentine tail.
visual_identity.silhouette: Compact birdlike body, raised leathery wings, rooster head with comb, two clawed legs, long curling reptilian tail.
visual_identity.head_features: Rooster-like head with hooked beak, prominent comb and wattles, fierce eyes.
visual_identity.body_shape: Small feathered torso transitioning into leathery wings and a scaled curling tail, with birdlike clawed legs.
visual_identity.surface: Sparse feathers on torso, smooth wing membranes, simple tail scales.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Exactly two clawed birdlike legs support the body, with one pair of leathery wings and one long serpentine tail. The head is rooster-like with beak, comb, and wattles; no extra legs or dragon forelimbs.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw one small compact hybrid with a rooster head and comb, one pair of leathery wings, exactly two clawed bird legs, and one long curling reptilian tail. Keep the torso birdlike and small; never turn it into a four-legged dragon or ordinary chicken.

accuracy_checks: wings differ from ordinary bird wings

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
